All of our production facilities recorded net loss for the first quarter of 2026. Hebei Shoulang

interest discounting expenses which are non-recurring in nature.
Quarterly Average Purchase Price of Industrial Off-gas
The average purchase price of industrial off-gas per Nm3 for each production facility
decreased in the first quarter in 2026 as compared with the quarterly average purchase price in 2025
except for Ningxia Binze, which price remained the same.
Unaudited Financial Information for the Three Months Ended March 31, 2026
Our revenue increased by 18.7% from RMB134.3 million for the three months ended March
31, 2025 to RMB159.4 million for the same period in 2026, primarily driven by (i) an increase of
3,747 tons in sales volume of ethanol as a result of the resumption of normal production activities
at Guizhou Jinze and the increase in production volume of Hebei Shoulang and (ii) an increase in
the average selling price of ethanol from RMB4,524 per ton to RMB4,696 per ton.

31, 2025 to RMB7.6 million for the same period in 2026. Our overall gross profit margin improved
from negative 19.4% to negative 4.8% over the same period. The improvements in gross loss and
gross margin were primarily attributable to the increase in production volume of ethanol, which also
led to a lower unit cost.

comprehensive income for the three months ended March 31, 2026 have been reviewed by our
